player_prompt.intro:
Sidae makkita Player {player_id} ri JoJoJoin, dimainka ri papan 5x5 sibawa sel-sel bernomor 0-24.
Ri giliranta, taruh tanda makkita ri sel-sel kosong, conto '[12]'.
ANRE makkita menang sawaegi makkita ri empat tanda makkita barisara — empat sel-sel berurutan horizontal, vertikal, atawa diagonal.
Sidae Player {player_id} makkita '{symbol}'; lawanta makkita '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Iyyaro appittangnge de'na naccoeri bentu iyya makessing.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} de'na ulle mancaji sel iya makessing. Harusu ri pallawangenna 0 sibawa 24.

game_action.placed: Player {player_id} taruh tanda makkita ({symbol}) ri sel {cell}.
